title: TokenX ledger vs Ad Click log vs chat sequencer
description: Three Module 7 cores. Same platform classes, opposite invariants: conservation, billed identity, per-conversation order.

cells.workload: Custodial transfers: debit/credit, spendable balance, cursor history. Illustrative envelope ~231 transfers/s average, ~4,630/s at 20× peak, ~46k peak authoritative reads/s. Notifications are a different path.
cells.consistency: One serializable ledger transaction, or exclusive cross-shard terminals (RESERVED→FINALIZED|RELEASED and ABSENT→CREDITED|CANCELLED). 2-of-3 (or equivalent) commit for the ledger group. Linearizable/read-your-writes on a {shard, epoch, position} token. Never LWW balances.
cells.latency: Target p99 transfer ack hundreds of ms in-region including WAL/quorum. Cross-shard adds coordinator UNRESOLVED waits. Cache hits are illegal for spendable reads.
cells.scaling: Partition by wallet_bucket when lock wait is measured. One celebrity wallet is a row lock, not an extra Kafka partition. Do not dual-write two regions.
cells.failure: Fail closed when authority, uniqueness, or a claimed fraud cap cannot be proven. Timeout is UNKNOWN: retry the same tenant-scoped key. Fence old epochs. Restore replays committed journals only — not signed request logs.
cells.costOps: You staff fenced failover, unique-key retention, outbox relay, and reconciliation of UNRESOLVED terminals. Analytics warehouses are extra derived cost.
cells.whenNot: When the product is billed ingest, chat append, or a redirect map. Do not put spendable money on a CRDT, a socket, or a CDN.

cells.workload: Keyed click ingest: illustrative 500M clicks/day, 12× peak ~70k/s, 400 B encoded, hot campaign ~8% of peak on one key. Minute windows and serving counters are derived.
cells.consistency: Authoritative fact is the append plus UNIQUE(click_id) inside a horizon ≥ replay. Partition order is not event time. Aggregates are versioned upserts. Dashboards may be labeled stale.
cells.latency: Ingest ack is produce+uniqueness, not window close. Dashboard p99 can be seconds behind a watermark. Hedged dashboard reads are allowed; hedged unkeyed POSTs are not.
cells.scaling: Shard uniqueness by click_id when campaign_id is hot. Collectors scale independently of window jobs. Consumer parallelism caps at partition count.
cells.failure: Fail open admission onto a bounded local cap if limiter Redis dies; keep click_id on the log. 429 is proven reject; produce timeout is UNKNOWN with the same click_id. DLQ has an owner. Do not park UNKNOWN into TokenX.
cells.costOps: Retention, uniqueness horizon, watermark lag, and hot-key ops. Replay rebuilds windows from the log. Sharing TokenX's ledger pool is an integrity incident.
cells.whenNot: Spendable balances, chat message order, or any path where a duplicate is minted money. A dashboard total is not an invoice.

cells.workload: Append opaque messages to a conversation. Illustrative ~5.5k commits/s average, ~55k/s at 10×, plus hundreds of thousands of socket pings/s. Presence and receipts ride along as derived facts.
cells.consistency: Total order is (conversation_id, seq) assigned in the same transaction as the message and outbox. Client message id is idempotent occupancy. Recipients agree on seq, not NTP. Presence is last-heartbeat plus TTL — allowed to be wrong across partitions.
cells.latency: Send ack p99 ~200 ms in-region for a committed text row. Catch-up of hundreds of messages is a different SLO. Socket push can lag without implying a lost commit.
cells.scaling: Partition by conversation_id. Hot groups are a sequencer bottleneck; celebrity rooms switch copy strategy (hybrid fan-out), not wall-clock order. A global sequencer serializes unrelated chats for no gain.
cells.failure: Sequencer/quorum loss rejects new seq; history reads of committed rows may continue. Retry send with the same client id. Do not invent seq on the gateway. Multi-region active-active appends need a named conflict story — LWW bodies are not that story. Not fail-closed money and not fail-open billed ingest.
cells.costOps: Socket drain, resume tokens, orphan multipart media, and fan-out backlog. Encryption keys stay on the client if E2E; the server stores ciphertext.
cells.whenNot: When you needed conservation or a billed unique fact. Do not treat Redis presence, Cassandra timestamps, or WebSocket arrival order as the log.

assumptions: Capacity numbers are the illustrative envelopes from the Module 7 lessons, not a measured fleet.
TokenX Kafka/outbox is derived integration after ledger commit (RF=3, acks=all, minISR=2 if you use that log). It is not a second wallet.
Ad Click Kafka-class log uses the same producer durability names; uniqueness horizon covers the replay window you promise.
Chat seq lives with the message row; sockets never assign seq.
Fail-closed money versus fail-open ads is product policy on admission and uniqueness stores, not a library default.
Single-region unless a cell names multi-region. Multi-region TokenX is one write region plus fencing, not LWW.
